title: Some combat testing
author: CashFirm573
selftext: So testing some of the new animations, can be rough to tell what's going on, to many monsters, but it's getting there slowly. Not sure if I should have screen shake or not, it can be annoying at times.

comments.author: Significant_Tell407
comments.body: Love the aesthetic and tone of the game.

replies.author: CashFirm573
replies.body: Thanks it's got a long way to go, there lot of content I didn't show more weapons and armor so on.

comments.author: StarMonkeyGames
comments.body:
initial thought is too much screen shake for common enemies. Save the big screen shake for rare+

scale down the feedback for the commons or you lose the vibe by spamming it for everything

replies.body: That was my thinking I was worried was my age lol and I was just old but good someone else noticed. Confirms my theory it's to much.
